api_limits: ssh2::Session::new calls libssh2_session_init_ex with default allocation callbacks; no custom allocator constructor exposed in 0.9.6.
ssh2::File::readdir allocates 4KiB per call and grows on BUFFER_TOO_SMALL; Sftp::readdir returns whole Vec without entry cap. Must not use unbounded high-level enumeration directly.
Vendored libssh2 sftp.c uses a 256KiB general packet cap but excludes matching READDIR NAME replies. A name/entry cap after the API returns is insufficient for peak allocation admission.
Session timeout and nonblocking API exist; cancellation, socket shutdown, cleanup and external crypto allocations need separate validation. No adoption decision based only on throughput.
